correctness.rationale: Reduce H−βI to radial 2x2 block [[δ,G],[G,0]] plus dark leaf projector P=I−uu^T. Distinct radial spectral projections have p_+p_-=s=G²/(δ²+4G²). Schur-squaring P and radial projectors yields Mhat with center 1−2s, center/leaf 2s*w_i, and leaf diag(1−2w_i)+2(1−s)ww^T. For m>=3 the leaf principal summand P∘P is positive definite: x^T(P∘P)x=||P diag(x)P||_F²=0 implies x_i/u_i²+x_j/u_j²=0 for each pair via z=u_j e_i−u_i e_j, and every triple forces all x_i=0. The other projectors have strictly positive center contribution, so full Mhat≻0. For m=2 independently expanded exact symbolic det Mhat=(1−4s)(w1−w2)², matching displayed δ/g expression, with rank2 at zero determinant since its center diagonal is >=1/2>1/3; m=1 2x2 eigenvalues 1 and 1−4s. Checked additional exact-rational illustrative profiles with m=1..4, including rank 1/2/3/4/5 boundaries; general proof does not rely on sampling.

value.rationale: A robust all-weights full-rank stability theorem and sharp 1-/2-spoke singularity classification for a natural arrowhead family; extends known uniform, zero-detuning unweighted star graph fact in a way relevant to heterogeneously coupled finite quantum systems. The exact boundary distinguishes detuning and coupling asymmetry.

final_claim: For weighted real star Hamiltonians with all nonzero couplings and equal leaf on-site energies, the Cesàro average mixing matrix has explicit block formula and full rank whenever m>=3; for m=2 rank3 iff central detuning δ≠0 and spoke magnitudes unequal, otherwise rank2; for m=1 rank2 iff δ≠0, otherwise rank1.
limitations: No inactive spokes, nonuniform leaf onsite energies, or flux-bearing complex edges.
An explicit literature access risk remains for the full Kimmerling dissertation.
